Mutations are scoped, not whole-repo. Saved latest distinct set: 36 detected, 1 surviving, 0 uncovered, 0 timed out. The survivor is ignore-unlock-expiry-cap. RestrictionEngine.consumeUsageDetailed (RestrictionEngine.kt:729-806) splits at unlockBoundary and stops when the mode no longer records usage, so removing the repository cap in bufferBrowsingUsageLocked (RestrictorRepository.kt:575-591) can be equivalent for current charging. The cap is still in source. Aggregate attempts are 58 detected, 8 surviving, 2 errored; the extra survivors and both errors are earlier trials later rechecked as detected, not current open bugs. RestrictorRepository.kt and evidence.mjs hashes in the mutation records match the current files.

Intentional behavior in the uncommitted diff, still manually unverified: live GPS distance uses the verification speed, accuracy, gap, and noise rules (GpsDistanceTracker.kt and evidence.mjs); verified meters replace the live count after a successful upload; paused gate copy shows minutes instead of the old headline; credit labels drop a trailing s. Repository accounting and agent chat were split without an obvious contract change in the moved branches. Non-monotonic GPS times are still uploaded and fail verification, while the live tracker skips them and can keep a distance (GpsDistanceRulesTest.kt:37-40). Rewards stay fail-closed because verifyGps rejects that recording.
